description: This Java class 'Bin2Header' is a utility tool that converts a binary file into a C/C++ header file containing the data as an array variable. It reads a binary file, generates a header file with include guards and array content in hex format, and outputs status messages.

classes.name: Bin2Header
classes.description: A utility class that provides a static main method to convert binary files into header file format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes input arguments, reads the binary file, and writes the corresponding C/C++ header file.
